# KIPSMTHN Creative Platform

KIPSMTHN is a creative business platform for photographers, filmmakers, studios, and creative teams. It provides a connected workspace for managing clients, projects, quotes, invoices, and private gallery delivery.

## Major Public Sections

- **Home** (`/`): Platform overview, features, workflow, and workspace modules
- **About** (`/about`): Platform information and creator profiles
- **Services** (`/services`): Production and creative storytelling services including:
  - Startup Ecosystem Storytelling (Accelerator & Donor Program Media)
  - Brand Films & Documentary Production
  - Commercial & E-Commerce Photography
  - Visual Identity, Motion & UI/UX Systems
- **Work** (`/work`): Portfolio archive across four creative pillars:
  - Photography
  - Videography
  - Branding & Graphic Design
  - UI/UX
- **Contact** (`/contact`): Direct inquiries and social channels

## Services Offered

KIPSMTHN provides commercial photography, brand films, motion graphics, and creative production services for African startup ecosystem programs, venture studios, and corporate clients. Based in Nairobi, Kenya with KRA eTIMS compliance.

## Note on Private Areas

The following areas are NOT public content and should not be indexed:
- `/admin/**` - Administrative interfaces
- `/api/**` - API endpoints
- Authentication routes (sign-in, sign-up, onboarding)
- Private client portal routes (`/portal/**`)
- Tokenized gallery URLs
- Internal/private routes

- Home: https://creative-platform.vercel.app/
